company.shortDescription: STEPPI is a corporate health and community engagement platform.
company.description: Steppi, a corporate health and community engagement platform that encourages users to be more active by allowing them to exchange daily steps for discounts.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that enables organizations to create and manage activity challenges where employees track steps and physical activity remotely.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual Challenges

productsAndServices.description: A real-time leaderboard system that displays participant rankings and progress during activity challenges to maintain engagement and motivation.
productsAndServices.name: Live Leaderboards

productsAndServices.description: A set of pre-designed communication resources including email templates and creative assets to support challenge promotion and participant motivation.
productsAndServices.name: Communication Tools

productsAndServices.description: A reporting feature that provides real-time data on participation, performance, and trends to help organizations recognize achievements and manage wellness programs.
productsAndServices.name: Data and Insights Reporting

productsAndServices.description: A feature allowing organizations to customize challenges with their branding, including logos, images, and messaging for a tailored participant experience.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Challenge Design

productsAndServices.description: Integration with multiple wearable devices and smartphones to automatically track steps and physical activity for all participants.
productsAndServices.name: Seamless Activity Tracking

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Corporate Round round raised $1,800,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,269,942 to $4,269,942, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 15 (-13).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
